The live API created PayPal orders for the generic publish branch and did not capture payment. GET /paypal/orders/{orderId} returned 404 for the created order IDs, so the API does not expose the PayPal amount breakdown needed to prove tax_total from the public response. The branch-specific source check remains the decisive failure for token_*, overlay, stitching, and moderation because those branches never read request country / state.

Bug Notes

  • Fail: country + state override is only implemented in buildOrderDataForProduct().
  • The main supported create-order branches ignore request country and state:
    • token_20|40|100|300|600 -> buildOrderDataForTokenPurchase() -> BuyTokenHelpers::validateAndPrepareTokenPurchase() uses stored billing info.
    • fov|gov|fovd -> buildOrderDataForUnlockOverlay() -> UnlockOverlayHelpers::validateAndPrepareOverlayUnlock() uses stored billing info.
    • stitching -> buildOrderDataForStitching() -> UnlockStitchingHelpers::validateAndPrepareUnlockStitching() uses stored billing country.
    • moderation -> buildOrderDataForUnlockModeration() -> UnlockModerationHelper::validateAndPrepareUnlockModeration() uses stored billing info.
  • This means a request payload can include country and state, but tax is not overridden for the common one-time products documented/collected under POST /paypal/orders.

Evidence

  • CLI/test output: node qa_testing\node_modules\@playwright\test\cli.js test --config=qa_testing\playwright.config.js qa_testing/api/payment/issue_920_create_order_tax_override_api.spec.js
  • Result: failed as expected on Task Sprint acceptance because the branch methods above do not read request country / state.
  • Live API output: powershell.exe -NoProfile -File qa_testing\scripts\run-issue-920-live-api.ps1
  • Result: live auth succeeded; publish CA/US payloads returned 200 with redacted order_id; token_20 and fov collection payloads returned 409 precondition responses before tax comparison.

Conclusion

Issue #920 is not fully implemented. The PayPal payload can display tax when a tax value is supplied, but the create-order action does not consistently use the request country and state to override tax across all supported product branches.
